---
title: "Session 6 · Tidy data and dplyr"
subtitle: "Express a transparent row-and-column pipeline"
---

## Learning goals

State the tidy-data rules, use the core dplyr verbs—including `if_else()` and
`case_when()`—distinguish grouped mutation from grouped summarization, and
translate a pipeline into equivalent base R logic.

## Materials

- [Slides](slides.qmd)
- [Guided lab](lab.qmd)
- Lab starter—choose one: `starter/dplyr-lab.Rmd` or `starter/dplyr-lab.qmd`

The lab asks you to choose either base R or dplyr for the main solution and verify
one important result with the other style.
